description: PyTorch DataLoader fork workers show identical command lines in ps aux — must check ppid before recommending kill
type: feedback
---

Never identify processes as "duplicates" solely based on matching command lines in `ps aux`. PyTorch DataLoader workers are forked from the training process and inherit the parent's full command line. They appear as separate PIDs with identical args.

**Why:** On 2026-05-21, I misidentified 4 DataLoader workers as "duplicate training processes" and recommended killing them. This crashed the legitimate Qwen s456 training at 93% completion (step 6200/6633), causing GPU 3 to go idle and disrupting the evaluation pipeline.

**How to apply:** Before recommending `kill` on any process:
1. Always check `ps -o pid,ppid,comm` to verify parent-child relationships
2. If multiple PIDs share the same command line, check if they share a common ppid — if so, they're likely worker children (DataLoader, multiprocessing pool, etc.)
3. PyTorch typically spawns `num_workers` DataLoader processes (default often 4) per training job
